subject: Exec sponsor demo — aligning VP/CIO attendance and calendar update
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@aerolith.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@aerolith.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec sponsor presence for pilot demo (VP & CIO)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — the team was impressed. We're preparing an internal exec briefing for the pilot decision and would like Redwood to present a 30–40 minute demo focusing on reliability, latency SLAs, and private deployment controls.

Key ask: can a senior technical sponsor from Redwood join (VP-level or above) and ideally your CTO-facing SE? Our VP of Product (Maya) and CIO will attend and want to see the deck and a short QA on security and deployment options.

Target windows this month: Jul 22–23 between 10:00–15:00 PT. We can be flexible but want to lock a time this week.

Also, any pre-read you can share (agenda + security checklist) would help prep the execs.

Cheers,
Alex Rivera
Head of Product, Aerolith
alex.rivera@aerolith.com

Attachments: none
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@aerolith.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@aerolith.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sponsor presence for pilot demo (VP & CIO)

Hi Alex — thanks for the clarity and the windows.

Short answers: yes, we can provide an exec-level sponsor and our senior SE (Karthik) to run the deep-dive. Ben (our Head of Sales Engineering) will join for the SLA/cost discussion.

I’ve attached a one-pager agenda and our security checklist for initial review. Proposed plan: 30 min demo + 10 min Q&A + 5 min next steps. If the CIO wants a short private chat about integrability, Karthik can stay on after the main session.

Proposed times I can confirm right now (PT):
- Thu Jul 22 — 11:00–11:45
- Fri Jul 23 — 13:00–13:45

If either works, I’ll loop in Laura (to confirm exec sponsor availability) and send an invite with a draft deck.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Aerolith_exec_demo_agenda_v1.pdf, Aerolith_security_checklist.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sponsor presence for pilot demo (VP & CIO) — internal

Sofia / Karthik — quick internal note.

I can cover the exec-sponsor ask but will be traveling on Jul 22–23. Laura, are you available to deputize as the ‘exec sponsor’ for Aerolith’s meeting? If not, I can ask our VP to join remotely, but I’d prefer Laura since she’s familiar with the pilot commercial terms.

Karthik — can you confirm availability for a 30–40 minute slot on 7/22 11:00 PT or 7/23 13:00 PT? Also confirm if you’ll need a dry-run (I recommend a 20–30m dry-run with the deck and the security slide).

I’ll hold both times tentatively on my calendar and prep the contract highlights.

-Ben
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@aerolith.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@aerolith.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sponsor presence for pilot demo (VP & CIO)

Alex / Maya — quick update after internal sync.

Laura can step in as the exec sponsor for this briefing. Karthik confirmed availability for Fri Jul 23 at 13:00 PT and Laura will join that slot in person/remote depending on travel logistics. Can you confirm that Fri 7/23 13:00–13:45 PT works for the Aerolith execs? Once you confirm, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read (deck + SOW draft).

Also attaching a draft SOW for your procurement team to glance at — it’s a pilot scope and intentionally slim. If procurement prefers, we can route a DocuSign link for signing after the exec meeting.

Next steps if confirmed:
- I’ll send the calendar invite with Zoom link (and separate Zoom breakout if the CIO wants a private follow-up)
- Karthik and Laura will do a 20m dry-run with our deck on Thu 7/22 at 09:00 PT (I'd like to invite Alex if time permits)
- Procurement can flag any SOW edits before we issue DocuSign

Thanks — Sofia
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: pilot-sow-draft.docx
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@aerolith.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@aerolith.com>, procurement@aerolith.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sponsor presence for pilot demo (VP & CIO) — CONFIRMED 7/23 13:00 PT

Sofia — thanks, that works. Confirming user list: our VP Product (Maya Singh), CIO (Thomas Hsu), and two procurement leads will attend.

Please send the calendar invite to confirm. We’d also appreciate the dry-run invite for Thu 7/22 09:00 PT; Alex (me) and Maya will try to join for 20 minutes.

On SOW: procurement will review the draft and follow up on redlines to procurement@aerolith.com. We prefer DocuSign after final review.

Appreciate you coordinating this on short notice — looking forward to the session.

Best,
Alex
Head of Product, Aerolith
alex.rivera@aerolith.com
